mapper.sql: select id, name, type, value, description, created_time, created_by, updated_time, updated_by from t_rbac_resource
mapper.insert: insert into t_rbac_resource (name, type, value, description, created_time, updated_time, created_by, updated_by) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{value}, #{description}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: select distinct r.`value` from `user` u join t_rbac_user_group ug on ug.user_id = u.id join t_rbac_group g on g.id = ug.group_id and g.enabled = 1 join t_rbac_group_role gr on gr.group_id = g.id join t_rbac_role rl on rl.id = gr.role_id and rl.enabled = 1 join t_rbac_role_perm rp on rp.role_id = rl.id join t_rbac_perm p on p.id = rp.perm_id and p.enabled = 1 join t_rbac_perm_resource pr on pr.perm_id = p.id join t_rbac_resource r on r.id = pr.resource_id where u.id = #{userId} and u.enabled = 1 and u.locked = 0 and r.type = '接口'
